actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.generate_image.props.fields.desc: The values to apply to the fields in the template.
actions.generate_image.props.format.desc: The format of the image to generate.
actions.generate_image.props.modificatio: The extra modifications to apply to the image. See "Detailed dynamic modifications" in https://robolly.com/docs/api-reference/
actions.generate_image.props.template_id: Select your template. (If you want to use Template ID. Click on the "(x)" above this field. Template ID can be found by opening a template and going to “Render”. Being there copy the template ID from the top right.)
actions.robolly_create_hidden_render_lin: Builds a signed render link that looks like a static file URL.

Element values keyed by element name, e.g. {"title": "Hello", "image": "https://…/photo.jpg"}. Use "<element>.<property>" keys for detailed changes, e.g. {"title.textColor": "red"}. Use List Template Elements to get the keys.
The template ID, e.g. "6416bcbab241242aa0b22ecb". Use List Templates to find it.
actions.robolly_create_template.descript: Creates a blank template in your Robolly account.
actions.robolly_create_template.props.ba: Canvas background color as a CSS color, e.g. "rgb(27, 61, 166)" or "#1b3da6".
actions.robolly_create_template.props.di: Yes rejects render links that have neither a signature nor an API key. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
actions.robolly_create_template.props.pa: An existing folder in the Robolly dashboard to list the template under. Robolly rejects a folder that does not exist.
actions.robolly_create_template.props.re: The file name given to rendered files.
actions.robolly_get_render.description: Gets one render by ID, with its status and file URL.
actions.robolly_get_render.props.renderI: The render ID, from List Renders.
actions.robolly_list_renders.description: Lists past renders, newest first, 30 per page.
actions.robolly_list_renders.props.cache: Only the render with this cache hash.
actions.robolly_list_renders.props.movie: Only renders with this movie ID.
actions.robolly_list_renders.props.templ: Only renders of this template. Use List Templates to find it.
actions.robolly_list_template_elements.d: Lists a template's elements and the modifications each one accepts.
actions.robolly_list_template_elements.p: The template ID, e.g. "6416bcbab241242aa0b22ecb". Use List Templates to find it.
actions.robolly_list_templates.descripti: Lists the templates in your Robolly account.
actions.robolly_render_template.descript: Renders a template as an image, PDF or MP4 and returns the file URL.
actions.robolly_render_template.props.dp: DPI from 1 to 1200, JPG and PNG only.
actions.robolly_render_template.props.du: Video length in milliseconds for MP4, up to 10000.
actions.robolly_render_template.props.fo: The output format. MP4 only works for animated templates.
actions.robolly_render_template.props.fp: Frames per second for MP4: 24, 30, 50 or 60.
actions.robolly_render_template.props.mo: Element values keyed by element name, e.g. {"title": "Hello", "image": "https://…/photo.jpg"}. Use "<element>.<property>" keys for detailed changes, e.g. {"title.textColor": "red"}. Use List Template Elements to get the keys.
actions.robolly_render_template.props.qu: Compression quality from 10 to 100, JPG only.
actions.robolly_render_template.props.sc: Output scale from 0.1 to 3. Defaults to 1.
actions.robolly_render_template.props.te: The template ID, e.g. "6416bcbab241242aa0b22ecb". Use List Templates to find it.
actions.robolly_update_template.descript: Updates a template's name and canvas settings.
actions.robolly_update_template.props.ba: Canvas background color as a CSS color, e.g. "rgb(27, 61, 166)" or "#1b3da6".
actions.robolly_update_template.props.di: Yes rejects render links that have neither a signature nor an API key. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
actions.robolly_update_template.props.pa: An existing folder in the Robolly dashboard to list the template under. Robolly rejects a folder that does not exist.
actions.robolly_update_template.props.re: The file name given to rendered files.
actions.robolly_update_template.props.te: The template ID, e.g. "6416bcbab241242aa0b22ecb". Use List Templates to find it.
auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to [Robolly](https://robolly.com/dashboard/).
2. Open your project and go to **API**.
3. Copy the API key and paste it here.
description: Robolly is the all‑in‑one service for personalized image, video & PDF generation with API
